name: OpenRouter free models
how_you_get_it: Create an OpenRouter key. Models whose id ends in :free cost nothing per token.
trap: Free models are rate-limited rather than granted, and the limit changes. A daily request cap is not a pot of money.

balance.why_not_api: GET /api/v1/key is documented to return limit and usage, but this catalog has not run it. An unproven probe ships as no probe at all.

coverage.note: free variants cost nothing per token; they are capped by rate, not by grant.
